catalysts.headline: Positive Phase 3 EMBARQ topline results for barzolvolimab in chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU); BLA targeted for 2027
catalysts.impact: Major positive catalyst for lead pipeline asset
catalysts.source: could not be independently re-verified with a primary source in this session (WebSearch budget exhausted); consistent with the company's own Q2 2026 earnings-release guidance of sharing 'topline results from our two Phase 3 trials...in the early fall,' which had been accelerated from an earlier Q4 2026 guide given in the Q1 2026 release — carried forward from the dashboard's existing (unverified) record

catalysts.headline: Celldex announces positive Phase 3 EMBARQ-CSU1 and EMBARQ-CSU2 topline results for barzolvolimab in chronic spontaneous urticaria: met primary endpoint (UAS7 change) and all key secondary endpoints at Week 12 across both dose regimens in ~1,939-2,000 patients; complete response rates ~42%-46% vs ~9%-13% placebo at Week 12, rising to 54% by Week 24; BLA submission targeted for 2027
catalysts.impact: 'sell the news' reversal -- stock fell sharply intraday despite positive data; reported magnitude ranges from about -10% to -37%+ depending on measurement point (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: H.C. Wainwright raised price target on Celldex to $64 from $42 (maintained Buy) following the Phase 3 data, implying ~90% upside

Celldex reports Q2 2026 results: net loss ~$73.5M (-$0.94/share), up ~30% YoY on higher R&D spend for barzolvolimab trials; revenue fell ~97% YoY to ~$22K; cash/marketable securities of $717.6M at quarter-end said to fund operations through 2028
catalysts.impact: Confirms well-capitalized balance sheet heading into the Phase 3 EMBARQ readout
catalysts.source: company Q2 2026 press release (summarized via quartr.com/ir.celldex.com search results); exact release link: https://ir.celldex.com/node/16736/html

catalysts.headline: Celldex reports Q2 2026 results: R&D expense $67.5M, G&A $13.1M, net loss $73.5M (-$0.94/share); no material revenue; cash/investments sufficient into 2028; flagged CSU Phase 3 and other barzolvolimab data due Sept./Oct. 2026
catalysts.impact: set up expectations for the Phase 3 readout

catalysts.headline: Celldex reports Phase 2 prurigo nodularis (PN) study of barzolvolimab MISSED primary endpoint (WI-NRS >=4-point improvement at Week 12) and key secondary endpoints, despite rapid tryptase suppression; company is discontinuing the PN program
Celldex reports Q1 2026 net loss of $78.7M (-$1.18/share)

catalysts.source: secondary aggregation of company Q1 2026 release

catalysts.headline: Celldex closed a $345M public offering (11,896,750 shares at $29.00/share, including full underwriter over-allotment) to fund the barzolvolimab pipeline
catalysts.impact: dilutive but bolstered cash to $717.6M by Q2 2026
